attributes.name: Request for Credit
attributes.short_description: Access bank credit facilities for your agricultural operations. Competitive rates and flexible terms.

why_apply_with_us: Simpl process – Apply from your phone in a few minutes.
Easy requirements – Start with your CNIC Number and basic farm details.
Affordable finance – Competitive rates designed for farmers.
Flexible repayment – Linked to your harvest cycle.
Trusted partners – Supported by cooperatives, buyers, and financial institutions.
Grow more, earn more – Finance for seeds, fertilizer, equipment, and farm labour.
eligibility_criteria: Must be 18 years or older with a valid CNIC.
Should be actively farming or involved in agriculture.
Should have access to own farmland or valid lease.
Loan should be for farm purposes only (seeds, fertilizer, equipment, labour).
Should be a member of a cooperative or have a buyer/off-taker agreement.

field_config.label: What is P.E.P.?
field_config.content: A Politically Exposed Person (PEP) is someone who holds, or has recently held, a prominent public position — such as a senior government official, politician etc. First-degree relatives (spouse, parent, child, sibling) and close associates of a PEP are also considered PEPs.

fields.label: Do you have any relative working in the Fauree?

field_config.label: What is Connected Party?
field_config.content: A Connected Party is an individual who has a direct personal or professional relationship with an employee, officer, or decision-maker of the organization or program.
